behavior_notes: The old unbound FreezeOrder write after /execute is removed for every action type.
The FreezeOrder is a governance quarantine record only; it does not stop trading. Command result carries governance_quarantine_only=true, trading_stopped=false and a notice.

Freezes outside paper candidate_artifact scope are refused with unsupported_freeze_scope and write nothing.
No already approved decision is migrated or executed, including the chain 4923 decision; services/governance behavior is not modified.
e2e: services/control-plane/bff/tests/test_evolution_freeze_execute_e2e.py drives the real BFF command routes and /bff/approvals/{id}/decide with the real Evolution app (EVOLUTION_AUTH_MODE=token) and the real Governance app (strict JWT) in process. The only seam is urllib.request.urlopen routing a host to the app and forwarding the exact emitted headers; any host other than evolution/governance fails the test (zero runtime, broker, capital calls). Negative cases: evolution_proposal record, pending, rejected, another tenant, changed proposal digest, Governance write failure, failure after the FreezeOrder write (retry reuses it, single cooldown), freeze outside paper artifact scope.
